title: Robot Waiter
titleZh: 咖啡店的機器人服務生
scene: Nina 和 Oliver 在辦公室休息時間，聊著網路上看到的機器人咖啡店新聞。

lines.en: Hey Oliver, did you see the news this morning?
lines.zh: 嘿 Oliver，你今天早上有看到新聞嗎？

lines.en: No, I didn't. What happened?
lines.zh: 沒有。發生什麼事了？

lines.en: I heard that a coffee shop in Seoul now has a robot waiter.
lines.zh: 我聽說首爾有一間咖啡店現在有機器人服務生。

lines.en: A robot? Really? I heard that it brings the drinks to your table.
lines.zh: 機器人？真的嗎？我聽說它會把飲料送到你的桌上。

lines.en: Yes! It's easy to come across videos of it online.
lines.zh: 對！在網路上很容易看到它的影片。

lines.en: Wow. Did you watch one?
lines.zh: 哇。你有看嗎？

lines.en: Yes, last night. It moved very slowly, but everyone was smiling.
lines.zh: 有，昨晚看的。它動得很慢，但大家都在笑。

lines.en: That's funny. Did it say anything?
lines.zh: 真有趣。它有說什麼嗎？

lines.en: Yes, it said, "Enjoy your coffee," in a very cute voice.
lines.zh: 有，它用很可愛的聲音說：「請享用咖啡。」

lines.en: I love it. Would you want one in our office?
lines.zh: 我喜歡。你會想在我們辦公室放一台嗎？

lines.en: Maybe. It would be convenient when we are too busy to leave our desks.
lines.zh: 也許吧。我們忙到離不開座位的時候會很方便。

lines.en: True. But I think it would spill the coffee on my keyboard.
lines.zh: 也對。但我覺得它會把咖啡灑在我的鍵盤上。

lines.en: Ha! That's what happened in the video, actually.
lines.zh: 哈！其實影片裡就發生了這種事。

lines.en: No way. What happened?
lines.zh: 不會吧。發生什麼事？

lines.en: A man asked for a cup of tea. The robot stopped in front of him and shook a little.
lines.zh: 有個男人點了一杯茶。機器人停在他面前，還抖了一下。

lines.en: Then what?
lines.zh: 然後呢？

lines.en: The tea went all over the table. The robot said, "Sorry, sorry!"
lines.zh: 茶灑得整張桌子都是。機器人說：「對不起，對不起！」

lines.en: That is so funny. Did the man get angry?
lines.zh: 太好笑了。那個男人生氣了嗎？

lines.en: No, he laughed. Then the staff came and cleaned everything up.
lines.zh: 沒有，他笑了。然後店員過來把一切清理乾淨。

lines.en: Good for him. I'd be a bit upset if it was my laptop.
lines.zh: 他真好。如果是我的筆電，我會有點不高興。

lines.en: Me too. The café said it will keep an eye on the robot from now on.
lines.zh: 我也是。咖啡店說之後會多盯著那個機器人。

lines.en: I should hope so. Does the robot work every day?
lines.zh: 希望如此。機器人每天都上班嗎？

lines.en: I heard that it only works on weekends, because that's when the shop is busy.
lines.zh: 我聽說它只在週末上班，因為那時店裡最忙。

lines.en: Smart. So the staff can focus on making the coffee.
lines.zh: 聰明。這樣店員就可以專心做咖啡。

lines.en: Exactly. The owner will announce soon that she wants two more robots.
lines.zh: 沒錯。老闆很快會宣布她想再買兩台機器人。

lines.en: Two more? I wonder how that will turn out.
lines.zh: 再兩台？不知道結果會變怎樣。

lines.en: I think it will turn out well. People love new things.
lines.zh: 我覺得結果會不錯。大家都喜歡新鮮的東西。

lines.en: Maybe. I like talking to real people, though.
lines.zh: 也許吧。不過我喜歡跟真人聊天。

lines.en: Me too. A robot can't ask, "How was your day?"
lines.zh: 我也是。機器人不會問：「你今天過得如何？」

lines.en: Right. Or remember my favorite drink.
lines.zh: 對。也不會記得我最愛喝的飲料。

lines.en: Well, I heard that some robots can learn names now.
lines.zh: 嗯，我聽說有些機器人現在可以學會記名字了。

lines.en: Now that is a bit scary. Next they will ask for my phone number.
lines.zh: 這就有點可怕了。接下來它們會跟我要電話號碼。

lines.en: Ha ha! Maybe they will want to be friends on social media.
lines.zh: 哈哈！也許它們還會想在社群媒體上加好友。

lines.en: Please. I already have too many messages to answer.
lines.zh: 拜託。我要回的訊息已經夠多了。

lines.en: Same here. Anyway, do you want to go and see the robot one day?
lines.zh: 我也是。話說回來，你哪天想去看看那個機器人嗎？

lines.en: Sure. If I ever go to Seoul, I'll try it.
lines.zh: 好啊。如果我去首爾，我會去試試。

lines.en: Good. Send me a photo if you do.
lines.zh: 好。如果你去了，傳張照片給我。

lines.en: Of course. I'll take a video, too, for the whole team.
lines.zh: 當然。我也會拍影片給全部同事看。

lines.en: Great. Now, shall we get back to our own coffee?
lines.zh: 太好了。那我們該回去喝我們自己的咖啡了吧？

lines.en: Yes. I need one badly before the next meeting.
lines.zh: 好。下次開會前我超需要來一杯。

lines.en: Come on, I'll buy. See, no robot needed!
lines.zh: 走吧，我請客。你看，不需要機器人！

quiz.q: What does the robot in the coffee shop do?
options: It brings drinks to the tables.
quiz.why: Oliver 說他聽說機器人會把飲料送到桌上。

quiz.q: What went wrong in the video?
quiz.why: The tea went all over the table.（茶灑得整張桌子都是。）
I heard that it only works on weekends.

words.ex1: It's easy to come across videos of it online.
words.ex2: I came across an old inspection report in the file cabinet.
words.ex2zh: 我在檔案櫃裡無意間找到一份舊的檢驗報告。

words.ex1: The café said it will keep an eye on the robot from now on.
words.ex2: Please keep an eye on the temperature of the oven during the test.
words.ex2zh: 測試期間請留意烤箱的溫度。

words.ex1: I wonder how that will turn out.
words.ex2: The new test method turned out to be faster than the old one.
words.ex2zh: 新的測試方法結果比舊的更快。

words.ex1: It would be convenient when we are too busy to leave our desks.
words.ex2: Is Thursday afternoon convenient for the factory visit?
words.ex2zh: 星期四下午參觀工廠方便嗎？

words.ex1: The owner will announce soon that she wants two more robots.
words.ex2: The company will announce the new quality policy next week.
words.ex2zh: 公司下週會公布新的品質政策。

speaking.patternZh: 我聽說……（轉述聽來的消息）
speaking.task: 用 I heard that... 說一個你最近聽到的有趣消息，再加一句你的感想。
speaking.example: I heard that a new coffee shop opened near my office. I want to try it this weekend.

reorder.zh: 我聽說首爾有一間咖啡店現在有機器人服務生。
我聽說它只在週末上班，因為那時店裡最忙。
我聽說新機器下週一會到。

part2.q: When will the new inspection machine arrive?
part2.why: 問 When（什麼時候），要回答時間。A 回答的是地點，B 回答的是價格。
part2.zh: 新的檢驗機器什麼時候會到？

part2.q: Is Thursday afternoon convenient for you?
part2.why: 這是 Yes/No 問句，問時間方不方便。B 重複了 afternoon，是陷阱。

part2.q: Why don't we announce the schedule today?
opts: Good idea. I'll send an email.
part2.why: Why don't we 是建議，不是真的問原因，要回答同意或不同意。C 用 Because 回答是陷阱。
part2.zh: 我們何不今天就公布時程？

part2.q: Could you keep an eye on the test results?
opts: Yes, the eye doctor is here.
Sure, I'll check them every hour.
part2.why: 這是請求，回答 Sure 最自然。A 的 eye doctor 是利用 eye 的聲音陷阱。
part2.zh: 你可以幫忙留意測試結果嗎？

part2.q: Do you want to ship by air or by sea?
part2.why: 這是選擇問句（A or B），要選一個。B 的 Yes 不能回答 or 問句。
part2.zh: 你想用空運還是海運出貨？
